raw.excerpt: Job Role Overview AutoRABIT is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers with demonstrated experience building both enterprise web applications and native iOS mobile applications.
raw.description:
Job Role Overview

AutoRABIT is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers with demonstrated experience building both enterprise web applications and native iOS mobile applications.

You will help develop a new product that automates the software delivery lifecycle for Salesforce teams. The platform connects customer Salesforce organizations, source control systems, and issue trackers to plan, build, validate, and deploy changes through a governed pipeline. AI agents perform delivery tasks within controls designed to ensure secure and reliable software releases.

Our technology stack includes Java and Spring Boot backend services, an Angular and TypeScript web application, Python services supporting automation and AI agents, and native iOS mobile development.

This is a true full stack engineering role requiring hands on experience across backend services, web applications, and iOS mobile development. Candidates must be comfortable working across multiple technologies, writing production code, and using AI coding tools as part of their daily development workflow.

Responsibilities:

Full Stack & Backend Development

  • Design, build, test, and deploy features across backend services, web applications, and mobile experiences.

  • Develop secure, scalable, multi tenant backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

  • Build responsive, accessible web applications using Angular and TypeScript.

  • Develop and maintain REST APIs that support web and mobile applications.

  • Extend Python services supporting delivery automation and AI powered workflows.

  • Design and evolve APIs using OpenAPI specifications and generated client integrations.

  • Ensure security, performance, reliability, and tenant data isolation across the platform.

iOS Mobile Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS development frameworks.

  • Build intuitive, responsive, and reliable mobile experiences that integrate with AutoRABIT's backend services.

  • Develop mobile interfaces using SwiftUI and established iOS architecture patterns.

  • Integrate iOS applications with REST APIs, authentication services, and enterprise systems.

  • Implement secure mobile authentication, session management, and data handling.

  • Troubleshoot mobile application performance, compatibility, and reliability issues.

  • Participate in mobile testing, debugging, deployment, and App Store release processes.

  • Ensure consistency and functionality across web and mobile user experiences.

AI & Automation

  • Contribute to AI powered automation supporting software development and delivery workflows.

  • Work with Python services and AI agent integrations that automate development tasks.

  • Use AI assisted coding tools to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality.

  • Evaluate AI generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to identify AI enabled product opportunities.

Engineering Quality & Collaboration

  • Build integrations with Salesforce, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jira, Slack, and other enterprise platforms.

  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, encryption, and credential management.

  • Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and end to end tests.

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker based builds, and AWS deployments.

  • Troubleshoot production issues across backend, web, and mobile applications.

  • Participate in code reviews and maintain engineering standards.

  • Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and DevOps teams.

  • Follow established security, compliance, and software development practices.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications.

  • Demonstrated professional experience developing and releasing native iOS mobile applications.

  • Strong hands on experience with Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, and the iOS development lifecycle.

  • Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services.

  • Strong Java development experience using Spring Boot, Spring Security, REST APIs, and modern enterprise development practices.

  • Strong Angular and TypeScript experience building modern web applications.

  • Working proficiency in Python, including maintaining and extending existing Python services.

  • Experience with Python testing and API frameworks such as pytest, FastAPI, and Pydantic.

  • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, database design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.

  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs using OpenAPI specifications.

  • Understanding of secure application development, authentication, authorization, and data protection.

  • Experience with automated testing across backend, web, and mobile applications.

  • Familiarity with Docker, AWS cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.

  • Hands on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor as part of regular software development.

  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.

  • Strong problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience developing software within the Salesforce ecosystem.

  • Experience building enterprise mobile applications or mobile experiences for SaaS platforms.

  • Experience with UIKit alongside SwiftUI.

  • Familiarity with mobile CI/CD, automated iOS testing, and App Store Connect.

  • Experience with push notifications, secure local storage, or mobile offline capabilities.

  • Experience with AI and LLM engineering, including agent frameworks, API integrations, tool use, Model Context Protocol, or prompt engineering.

  • Experience developing applications in highly regulated or security sensitive environments.

Compensation
$150,000 - $170,000 depending on experience.

Why Join AutoRABIT?

This is an opportunity to help build an innovative enterprise software platform that combines modern web technologies, native mobile development, and AI powered automation.

You'll work across the full technology stack, contribute to meaningful product decisions, and help deliver secure, scalable applications that improve how enterprise Salesforce teams develop and release software.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, embrace AI as a practical development tool, and are excited to build exceptional software across web and mobile platforms.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE. You must live in and be eligible to work in the US.

raw.description:
About ShadowDragon

ShadowDragon provides OSINT tools that help organizations identify individuals, investigate digital activity, and monitor evolving threats across online environments. Built for law enforcement, government, and enterprise security teams, we support the full intelligence workflow from identity resolution to investigation and ongoing monitoring. Our platform enables users to analyze publicly available data, uncover relationships, and generate actionable intelligence with speed and clarity. ShadowDragon helps teams move from fragmented data to structured intelligence so they can make informed decisions, respond faster, and operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital landscape.

About the role

ShadowDragon is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to lead Marketing Operations and HubSpot execution while supporting key Sales Operations initiatives. Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, this role will work closely with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Sales to improve systems, processes, data, and reporting across the customer journey.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can strengthen marketing operations, improve data quality, support scalable processes, and translate revenue data into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in HubSpot and understands how marketing activity connects to qualified opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.

What you'll do

  • Improve HubSpot across Marketing and Sales, including CRM structure, workflows, automation, campaigns, lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, attribution, reporting, and data governance.
  • Lead the day-to-day execution of Marketing Operations and support Marketing in operationalizing campaigns, events, paid media, content, website conversions, and other demand-generation programs.
  • Build and maintain campaign-tracking and attribution frameworks that connect marketing investment and activity to leads, qualified opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Develop dashboards and recurring insights covering funnel conversion, lead quality, campaign performance, pipeline creation, cost per qualified opportunity, and channel effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate contact, company, account, and opportunity data while improving enrichment, segmentation, associations, and overall database health.
  • Support Sales Operations projects and day-to-day needs in partnership with the Director of Revenue Operations.
  • Manage and optimize integrations across HubSpot and the broader sales and marketing technology stack.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve lead follow-up, routing, campaign execution, and reporting.
  • Establish clear documentation, governance, and quality-control processes for operational changes.
  • Translate performance data into practical recommendations for Marketing, Sales, and Revenue leadership.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related B2B SaaS role.
  • Advanced, hands-on HubSpot experience, including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, workflows, campaigns, attribution, reporting, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and data management.
  • Strong understanding of B2B demand generation, campaign operations, funnel analytics, and marketing-to-revenue measurement.
  • Experience with campaign tracking, paid-media measurement, UTM governance, event attribution, lead routing, and marketing automation.
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations for Marketing, Sales, and executive leadership.
  • Strong project management, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic projects with hands-on system administration and execution.

Become a part of our caring community

The Medical Director relies on broad clinical expertise to review Medicare drug appeals (Part D & B). The Medical director works assignments involve that moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires a case-by-case consideration of the Medicare rules, Humana policies and medical necessity.
The Medical Director's work includes computer-based review of moderately complex to complex appeals for coverage for drugs using resources outlined above as well as inter- and intra-departmental resources. Medical Directors will learn Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage requirements and will understand how to operationalize this in their daily work.

raw.description:
Xpera Risk Mitigation & Investigation (Xpera) is Canada’s premier national provider of risk mitigation services. Our comprehensive offerings empower clients to enhance business performance and maintain operational continuity by equipping them with the expertise and tools necessary to manage risks at all levels. Our innovative solutions encompass investigations, labour dispute management, evacuation support, emergency security, and emergency staffing. With these solutions, we collaborate with our clients as a proactive partner, poised to assist them in addressing current crises or developing strategies to mitigate potential future risks. More information about Xpera can be found at .

Adventurous, respectful, determined: We lead with ‘yes’, trust in our shared expertise, embrace innovation while holding each other accountable to our shared vision.

Reporting to the Regional Manager, the Private Investigator, Surveillance will be responsible for conducting thorough and detailed covert surveillance investigations both by vehicle and/or on foot. The successful candidate must share a passion for investigations and display an unwavering commitment to excellence. They must also possess a professional demeanor characterized by integrity, good character, and mutual respect. You are an individual who is enthusiastic and positive, a self-starter and quick learner with an ability to demonstrate patience and persistence, ensuring quality services to our clients and customers. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects and grow your career in a dynamic, supportive environment. If you're driven by purpose, thrive on challenge, and want to make a tangible impact, Xpera is the place to grow your career and be part of a trusted, forward-thinking team.

We welcome applications from candidates seeking either full-time or part-time employment. Flexible work arrangements may be considered for the right candidate.

What You Will Do:

  • Offer timely and quality best-in-class experience and services to our clients and customers.
  • Respond to client requests with a quick, flexible, and operational approach that is based on sound strategy, and coordinated with Xpera’s policies and procedures.
  • Conduct investigations in a manner that makes strategic sense and that are coordinated with the client’s intent, seeking guidance from management as required.
  • Conduct assignments in a proper investigative sequence including pre-operation planning, assignment assessment, evidence collection, and reporting.
  • Monitor closely assignment timelines and budgets to ensure assignments are completed on time and within budget.
  • Produce accurate, detailed notes and reports in accordance with Xpera’s protocol and practices.
  • Obtain professional quality video and photographic documentation of subjects.
  • Obtain information or intelligence in a legal, ethical, and confidential manner as required.
  • Attend court or legal proceedings as required.
  • Maintain vehicle and equipment in good working conditions, suitable for work and functions.

What You Will Bring:

  • Post-secondary education or equivalent combination of post-secondary education and relevant work experience with preference given to candidates with a minimum of 2 years of field surveillance investigative experience.
  • Experience working in a client-focused environment.
  • Experience in law enforcement is an asset.
  • A valid Private Investigator within the applicable province of employment.
  • A valid Driver’s License and satisfactory driving record.
  • Knowledge of all levels of the Canadian court system, criminal and civil code in Canada, insurance law, and privacy legislation is an asset.
  • An understanding of threat risk assessments and analytics.
  • Exceptional communication and written skills.
  • An ability to work autonomously and as part of a team.
  • A strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially with Word and Excel.
  • An ability to work under pressure to meet demanding timelines while maintaining focus on the task at hand.

Why Work With Us:

Hourly Rate: $24.00-$27.00 CAD per hour.

  • Opportunity for paid overtime.
  • Great employee perks including discounted gym memberships, shopping discounts, and recognition awards.
  • Employee referral incentives.
  • Business casual environment.
  • Opportunity for career growth and development.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.

We serve a diverse population across Canada and beyond. We strive to reflect that diversity within our workforce and ensure that every employee can be their authentic self.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates throughout the recruitment and assessment process.

In accordance with Human Rights and Accessibility legislation, Xpera is an equal opportunity employer who is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process. Applicant should advise Human Resources if they require any type of accommodation during the recruitment process.

Unsolicited Outreach Statement – Recruitment Agencies:

Xpera Risk Mitigation & Investigation will not accept unsolicited resume submittals from third-party recruiters and hereby request agencies to not contact Xpera employees or managers directly to present candidates. Xpera welcomes resumes submitted directly from candidates.

raw.description:
About Soracom

At Soracom, our mission is Making Things Happen for a World That Works Together. We believe technologies, including connectivity, cloud and AI, have the power to transform industries, enable innovation, and help businesses solve real-world challenges. From startups launching their first connected product to global enterprises managing millions of devices, we empower our customers to bring their ideas to life and operate efficiently and reliably.

With remote teams across Japan, the US, and Europe, Soracom continues to expand its global team to keep pace with the company's rapid growth. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in the diversity of our employees, valuing the unique experiences, perspectives, and expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. We believe in Developing a Dream Team by hiring exceptional people, investing in their growth, and creating an environment where individuals and teams can do their best work.

The ability to develop groundbreaking technologies is one of our key assets, and our people make it happen. Come join Soracom and help create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world!

Desired Qualities

With over a decade of experience and the power of cutting-edge technology, we continue to embrace the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe our success is driven by a team of curious, action-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-moving and global environment.

In addition to strong professional expertise, we look for people who:

  • Take ownership and work autonomously with a hands-on mindset.
  • Adapt quickly to change and stay flexible in new situations.
  • Approach others with integrity, empathy, and mutual respect.
  • Stay curious and informed about new technologies and trends.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer with proven experience and a passion for helping customers get greater value from technology solutions. Working collaboratively with Soracom's sales and product teams, you will serve as a trusted technical partner to customers across the full customer lifecycle.

A key focus of this role is to deepen and grow existing customer relationships by identifying new use cases, expanding deployments, introducing additional Soracom services, and helping customers move successfully from proof of concept into production and wider adoption. You will also support new customer acquisition through technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and other presales activities.

Measures of success include customer expansion and adoption, upselling and cross-selling, customer satisfaction, successful progression from proof of concept to production, new customer acquisition, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the technical relationship with customers across the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sales discovery and proof of concept through onboarding, production deployment, adoption, and expansion.
  • Partner with the sales team to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, including new use cases, additional devices, and adoption of additional Soracom services, and provide the technical expertise needed to progress these opportunities.
  • Develop trusted relationships with customers' technical stakeholders and act as a technical advisor, using deep technical knowledge and subject matter expertise to understand their architecture, challenges, and future requirements.
  • Lead technical discovery and solution design for both existing customers and prospects, translating business and technical requirements into appropriate Soracom solutions.
  • Design and deliver customer-specific demonstrations, presentations, architecture discussions, and proofs of concept that clearly communicate how Soracom's technology can address customer needs.
  • Guide customers through technical onboarding, architecture reviews, and production deployment, and coordinate with internal support and engineering teams to help resolve technical challenges.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to communicate customer requirements, recurring technical challenges, and opportunities for future product enhancements.
  • Stay current with developments in IoT, telecommunications, cloud, networking, and related technologies, and act as a technical thought partner to the sales team and customers.
  • Create technical sales enablement materials, including demonstrations, videos, documentation, and training, to improve the effectiveness and scalability of the sales organisation.
  • Gather and document competitive intelligence and provide technical insights that help strengthen Soracom's positioning in customer engagements.

Requirements

Key Requirements

  • Proven work experience as a Sales Engineer or other customer-facing technical roles (professional services, solutions architect, technical consultant, etc.)
  • Proven track record of successfully selling complex SaaS solutions
  • Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following areas (experience across multiple areas is highly desirable):
    • Architecting and developing products or solutions involving both software and hardware.
    • Architecting, building, and operating production systems using public cloud technologies and services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
    • Strong knowledge and practical experience in network infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewalls, TCP/IP, and related technologies.
  • Ability to build strong, long-lasting relationships with colleagues and customers
  • Ability to explain and present complex technology concepts clearly and in an easy-to-understand manner
  • Solid multi-tasking, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Self-starter and quick learner with a strong desire to continually learn new tools and technologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English as well as strong presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel as required
  • Experience working remotely in a multicultural environment
  • Experience supporting customers through implementation, adoption, and expansion

Preferred Requirements

  • Professional experience in the IoT ecosystem
  • Cloud certification in AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Experience supporting RFP and RFI responses as part of a sales or technical sales process
  • Professional proficiency in French

Location

Fully remote, with base in the UK or Europe.

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment - work from wherever you want - as long as you have a quality internet connection
  • Flexible work hours - maximise productivity and work-life balance while accommodating customer needs and team collaboration
  • Technology budget - work with the most up-to-date tools and leading AI platforms to help you innovate, learn, and do your best work
  • Skills-based career progression - advance based on impact, contribution, and performance rather than tenure
  • A truly rewarding culture - work with individuals from across the world who are at the very top of their game

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for our Cloud Sync platform. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and fellow technical leaders to design scalable solutions, establish engineering standards, and drive strategic initiatives across a critical product ecosystem. You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping teams navigate complex architectural decisions while ensuring quality, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

As a key technical leader, you will help modernize legacy synchronization services, improve platform reliability and performance, and advance our cloud-first architecture. You'll influence technical strategy, mentor engineers, lead architectural discussions, and serve as a go-to resource for solving complex distributed systems challenges while driving continuous improvement across the engineering organization.

This position is remote within the United States with up to 10% travel as needed.

What You Will Do
  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable, highly available software solutions
  • Develop and communicate cross-team technical strategies and architectural standards
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship through code reviews, design reviews, and pair programming
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and delivery plans
  • Establish and promote best practices around software design, maintainability, security, and performance
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across applications, systems, and engineering processes
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions that support business objectives
  • Facilitate architectural discussions across multiple teams and domains, ensuring alignment with company-wide technology direction
  • Lead engineering guilds and contribute to the growth and development of engineering talent
  • Investigate complex technical challenges and drive resolution through thoughtful analysis and collaboration

Technologies We Use:
  • Programming Languages: C# , C++, and Java
  • Communication Frameworks: gRPC and API development/integration
  • Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL and Redis
  • Architecture & Systems Design: Distributed systems, client-server architecture, and cloud-connected applications
  • Software Engineering Practices: Object-oriented design, software architecture patterns, code reviews, and SOLID principles
  • AI/ML Technologies: LLMs, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering; agentic frameworks and orchestration; model evaluation and monitoring; AI-assisted developer tooling

What We Are Looking For
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing and delivering complex, enterprise-scale software systems
  • Expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, client-server architecture, object-oriented design, and engineering best practices
  • Proven ability to create technical designs, architectural documentation, and scalable solutions while influencing technical decisions across teams
  • Problem-solving skills and experience diagnosing and resolving complex production issues
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, driving software quality, and elevating team capabilities
  • A natural collaborator with excellent communication skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and build alignment without direct authority
  • A hands-on technical leader who combines strategic thinking, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning to deliver meaningful business outcomes

What Will Set You Apart
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Experience with cloud-based applications and service-oriented architectures
  • Familiarity with modern API frameworks, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams


The posted range for this position is $150,000 - $165,000, which is the expected starting salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including prior experience, current skills, location/labor market, internal equity, etc.This position is eligible for a bonus target not reflected in the range.

What You’ll Gain as a #TeamSchein Member

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer who builds data infrastructure with velocity and precision. You’ll design pipelines, architect lakehouse solutions, and create the foundation that powers our products—leveraging modern AI tools to move faster without sacrificing quality. You bring deep experience with ClickHouse, open-source data tooling, and modern lakehouse patterns.

Our Stack

  • Primary Database: Postgres
  • Languages: Python, TypeScript
  • Infrastructure: Azure, event-driven architecture

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement lakehouse architecture using open-source technologies
  • Build and optimize ClickHouse deployments for high-performance analytical workloads

  • TypeScript proficiency for integration with application services
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, etc.) as part of your daily workflow

Skills

Who we are

OSCAR Pro, a leading Electronic Medical Records (EMR) platform in Canada, is part of the WELL Health Technologies family. Initially developed by McMaster University’s Department of Family Medicine, OSCAR Pro was built on a foundation of collaboration to improve healthcare delivery and patient outcomes. We have integrated innovations from various OSCAR service providers to offer a robust, secure, and versatile solution tailored to the diverse needs of clinics of all sizes.

Our platform empowers healthcare providers by streamlining administrative tasks, enhancing clinic efficiency, and enabling more time for patient care. With features like digital patient engagement, secure messaging, and seamless integration with other healthcare systems, OSCAR Pro reduces the administrative burden on clinics and improves the overall patient experience.

Our mission is to empower practitioners to deliver high-quality care while spending less time on administration. By providing cutting-edge digital tools, we ensure that healthcare professionals can focus on what truly matters—improving patient outcomes and experiences.

Who we need

Reporting to the Team Lead, we are seeking a Tier 1 Technical Support Analyst who is motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to healthcare technology. You will provide front-line assistance to healthcare professionals, helping them resolve technical issues, improve their workflows, and fully leverage our software to deliver better patient care. You will also collaborate with internal teams to strengthen support processes, enhance documentation, and contribute to the overall reliability and effectiveness of our platform.

This is an existing, 1 year contract remote opportunity open to candidates across Canada, with the exception of Quebec due to provincial employment requirements. Shift hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time.

What’s in it for you

Impact. By ensuring healthcare professionals can efficiently use our platform, you will directly impact how they deliver patient care. Your support will help reduce administrative burdens, allowing clinics to focus on what matters most—improving patient outcomes.

Technical challenges and exposure. You will gain valuable exposure to healthcare systems, electronic medical records, and billing processes such as OHIP and BCP, while building technical expertise in software support and system administration.

Career growth. You will join WELL Health, a leading Canadian digital health company that operates and owns outpatient medical clinics while also delivering a broad suite of technology and telehealth solutions. This Tier 1 support role offers a clear progression path to Tier 2 and Tier 3 support or other teams, such as onboarding, training, and implementation.

As our new Technical Support Specialist, you will focus on:

  • Support. You will help healthcare professionals apply the software effectively in their daily work, ensuring they achieve maximum value from the platform. You will provide phone and ticket-based support to healthcare providers and clinics using the EMR system, guiding users through product features, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely resolution.
  • Documentation. You will create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly guides for both customers and internal teams.
  • Process improvement. You will partner with internal teams on projects, escalate issues when required, and share insights to prevent recurring problems. You will identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce friction for customers, and enhance the overall support experience.

You bring:

  • The customer focus. You are motivated to support healthcare professionals and can clearly and patiently explain technical concepts. You approach every interaction with professionalism, empathy, and a strong commitment to service.
  • The technical experience. You have customer service, call centre, or technical support experience. You possess technical aptitude and are comfortable working with software, as well as independently troubleshooting issues and researching solutions.
  • The problem-solving skills. You are analytical and resourceful, with the ability to isolate, define, and resolve technical issues efficiently. You apply structure and rigour to your work, balancing accuracy with timely delivery.
  • The growth mindset. You are adaptable and eager to expand your technical skills. You stay engaged in dynamic environments with evolving customer needs and are committed to continuous learning.
  • The professionalism. You have strong written and verbal communication skills, meticulous attention to detail in documentation, and a respect for compliance and privacy standards in healthcare technology.

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology.

As a scaling company backed by WELL Health Technologies, we are expanding rapidly across the country. At OSCAR Pro, we are driven by a passion to make a lasting impact on the healthcare system. Our team is dedicated to building resilient, compliant, and easy-to-use technology that transforms how care is delivered.

Transformation starts with a strong team.

We believe that empowering our team members is critical to success. At OSCAR Pro, we foster a culture of respect where every individual feels valued, included, and supported to reach their full potential. Our workplace embraces diversity and prioritizes the well-being of our team and the communities we serve.

We offer a remote-first work environment, opportunities for growth within OSCAR Pro or across the broader WELL Health Technologies Group, and a supportive culture that balances professional success with personal well-being. Whether you are driving projects that shape the future of healthcare or focusing on your development, we are here to support you.

At OSCAR Pro, your ideas can make a real difference—not just in our organization but in the lives of patients and healthcare providers across Canada.

Apply now

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? We know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A final virtual interview with the Team Lead and Director, Customer Support. You will have the opportunity to learn more about the role and team as well as ask any final questions.

The salary for this position is $55,000. At OSCAR Pro, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

OSCAR Pro is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success.

raw.description:
Charger Logistics Inc. is a world-class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger Logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continues to grow.

Charger Logistics is seeking an experienced Senior Claims & Litigation Paralegal – Transportation to join our in-house Legal Department. This person will work closely with in-house counsel and outside litigation counsel in managing a significant portfolio of U.S. transportation-related litigation and claims.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support commercial-auto bodily injury, catastrophic-loss, property-damage and transportation litigation/claims.
  • Coordinate immediate evidence preservation following significant accidents, including driver qualification/personnel records, ELD/HOS, telematics/GPS, ECM data, dashcam/video, maintenance/inspection records, dispatch communications, bills of lading, photographs, police reports and witness information.
  • Review accident reports, demand packages, medical records and claim documentation and prepare litigation chronologies.
  • Under attorney supervision, prepare first drafts of answers, responses, affidavits/declarations, notices, motions and other litigation documents.
  • Assist with interrogatories, requests for production/admission, subpoenas, discovery, document collection and legal holds.
  • Prepare exhibits, document and medical summaries, deposition/mediation materials and trial binders.
  • Maintain complete litigation files and calendars and track pleading, discovery, deposition, mediation, motion and trial deadlines.
  • Maintain concise case summaries identifying allegations, damages, exposure, defence strategy, deadlines and next steps.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel, monitor case strategy/budgets/deadlines and assist with review of outside counsel invoices and litigation expenses.
  • Coordinate with Claims, Safety, Operations, Maintenance, Insurance/Risk Management and other departments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of litigation, claims or senior paralegal experience. Strong preference for trucking/transportation litigation, commercial-auto liability, catastrophic-loss or insurance-defence experience.
  • Experience with a motor carrier, insurer, TPA, self-insured transportation company or transportation-defence law firm is highly desirable.
  • Candidate should have strong U.S. litigation/discovery knowledge, legal drafting ability, docket/file management skills and familiarity with trucking evidence and FMCSA-related documentation.

Benefits

    • Competitive Salary
    • Healthcare Benefit Package
    • Career Growth
    • A stable and structured work environment, ideal for experienced law clerks looking for a balanced, well-organized workload.
    • Focus on internal legal matters and file support — no external client development or business-generation pressure.
    • The opportunity to apply your expertise across a genuinely varied litigation, enforcement, corporate, and regulatory caseload within a growing North American organization.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

  • We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Commercial Transportation Resolution Specialists to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for communicating with customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. This role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim. The claims you will handle will be commercial transportation (interstate trucking) related.

    The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through and design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome.

    Resolution Specialists are:
  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. Excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate specialists who care about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. Exercises empathy and patience towards everyone interacted with.
  • Sense of urgency - AT ALL TIMES. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. Finding the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the client’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational. Working toward a win/win claim resolution.
  • Curious. Wanting to know the whole story so the right decisions are made early and take action to prompt a quick resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. Not just wishing things were done differently but taking the appropriate actions to ensure it.
  • Communicative. Professional written and oral communication with all parties to a claim.
  • And did we mention a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous, and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, texts, and/or emails in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and educate them on the claims process and next steps.
  • Manage an inventory of claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim.
  • Work with the APD team on the handling of property damage claims.
  • Recognize recovery opportunities with regard to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss.
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority.
  • Provide input to continuously develop claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements.
  • Know the claims inside and out and ensure outside investigative service providers, including independent appraisers and defense counsel, are guided based on what we need to move the file to a quick and appropriate resolution. All the while keeping our clients updated where needed.
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of claims statutes, recent/updated court decisions impacting the claims function, current internal guidelines, and policy changes and modifications.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience concentrated in commercial transportation (interstate trucking) claims adjusting, ideally with:
      • Third-party bodily injury, including catastrophic losses
      • UM/UIM bodily injury
      • Litigation experience
      • MCS90 and its state equivalents
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state-required testing.
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Willingness to travel for clients and claims need

    Benefits
  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

RRD provides marketing, packaging, print, and business services to the world’s most respected brands. raw.description:
Principal Polymer Processing Engineer

Injection Molding

Location: Largo, FL (Remote)
Department: Engineering / Operations
Job Category: Engineering
Career Track: Individual Contributor
Job Profile: Principal Engineer
Reports To: Sr. Director Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
FLSA Status: Exempt

***This position is not eligible for employer-based sponsorship***


Position Summary

The Principal Polymer Processing Engineer is a recognized technical expert responsible for advancing injection molding capabilities, polymer processing technologies, and manufacturing performance across CONMED. This role provides technical leadership for the plastic parts design geometry for injection molding manufacturability; for new injection molds design conceptualization, manufacturing and performance testing; for the plastic injection molding cell equipment selection and performance testing; for the plastic injection molding process optimization and qualification; and for the sustaining support of the plastic injection molding process and mold’s production life cycle maintenance for plastic parts used to manufacture medical devices and components. Working across Engineering, Operations, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, and external partners, the Principal Polymer Processing Engineer leads highly complex technical initiatives from concept through commercialization and ongoing production. The individual serves as a trusted technical advisor, applying advanced engineering judgment to solve critical processing challenges; establishing technical standards; reducing manufacturing risk; and improving product quality, cost, capacity and reliability.


This is an individual-contributor position that leads through technical expertise, influence, and cross-functional collaboration rather than direct people management.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Leadership and Process Development

  • Serve as a Technical Advisor to Sourcing and Quality in custom molders facilities; molding cells equipment; injection molding process optimization and troubleshooting; mold design and manufacturing; mold preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and tooling engineering; metrology and MSA; and quality engineering technical capacities & capabilities assessment, and periodic audits.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in part design conceptualization for injection molding manufacturability; injection molding process optimization; injection molding process engineering (troubleshooting); mold design concept optimization; and mold tooling engineering (troubleshooting).
  • Lead the development, optimization, qualification and validation of complex injection molding processes, equipment, molds and supporting technologies.
  • Establish robust processing strategies based on polymer science, material characteristics, part design, mold design, equipment capability, and intended product requirements.
  • Apply scientific molding principles and structured experimentation to define processing windows and ensure repeatable, capable, and controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Provide technical direction for challenging molding applications involving tight tolerances, complex geometries, engineered resins, high-performance polymers, multi-material components, insert molding, overmolding, or other specialized processes.
  • Evaluate emerging polymer-processing technologies and recommend investments that support product innovation, manufacturing capability, capacity, quality, and long-term business needs.
  • Develop and maintain technical standards, engineering practices, design guidelines, specifications, and process-development methodologies.
  • Translate complex technical information into clear recommendations for engineering, operations, and business leadership.

New Product and Technology Development

  • Partner with R&D, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Supply Chain to support new product development and product-transfer activities.
  • Provide design-for-manufacturability guidance related to polymer selection, molded-part design geometry, tooling strategy, tolerances, gating, cooling, shrinkage, warpage, and process capability.
  • Lead or provide technical oversight for mold-flow analysis; tool design reviews; mold manufacturing and performance testing; process characterization; equipment selection and performance testing; and manufacturing-readiness assessments.
  • Identify technical risks early in the development process and establish appropriate mitigation plans.
  • Lead the transition of injection-molded products and processes from development through validation, commercialization, and sustained production.
  • Define critical process parameters and support the development of appropriate inspection, monitoring, and control strategies.
  • Ensure that technical decisions balance product performance, patient and user needs, compliance, manufacturability, cost, capacity, and business continuity.

Process Validation and Compliance

  • Provide technical leadership for mold bench assembly and functional performance assessment; mold installation qualification; molding cell equipment assessment and performance testing; mold dry cycling, mold first out-of-tool and mold functional performance testing; molding process characterization and optimization; plastic forming steel compliance assessment and, if applicable, tweaking (grooming); mold operational qualification; and mold performance qualification activities.
  • Develop or approve technical protocols, reports, engineering studies, acceptance criteria, statistical analyses, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure polymer-processing activities comply with applicable quality-system requirements, engineering standards, regulatory expectations, and internal procedures.
  • Support risk-management activities, including process FMEAs, design FMEAs, control plans, process-risk assessments, and technical investigations.
  • Partner with Quality Engineering to establish effective process controls and ensure sustained process capability.
  • Provide technical support during internal audits, external audits, regulatory inspections, and customer inquiries, as needed.

Manufacturing and Business Performance

  • Lead the resolution of complex or recurring molding process and/or tooling issues affecting safety, quality, delivery, capacity, cost, or customer service.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methods and advanced data analysis to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Improve manufacturing performance through cycle-time reduction, scrap reduction, yield improvement, process-capability improvement, automation, tooling optimization, and material utilization.
  • Develop solutions that increase process reliability, reduce variation, and improve overall equipment and operational effectiveness.
  • Assess existing molding equipment, auxiliary systems, tooling, and processes to identify capability gaps, obsolescence risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support capital-equipment selection, technical justification, supplier evaluation, installation, qualification, and production implementation.
  • Provide technical leadership for design changes, material changes, product transfers, process transfers, supplier transitions, capacity expansion, and manufacturing-network initiatives.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations supported by technical evidence, risk assessment, financial impact, and implementation requirements.

Technical Influence and Collaboration

  • Act as a technical consultant to engineering teams, operations leaders, project teams, and senior leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives that may span multiple products, departments, suppliers, or manufacturing locations.
  • Influence decisions where technical complexity, business risk, or organizational impact is significant.
  • Build effective partnerships with equipment manufacturers, toolmakers, resin suppliers, contract manufacturers, consultants, and other external technical resources.
  • Represent manufacturing and polymer-processing considerations in product, technology, and business-planning discussions.
  • Facilitate technical reviews and ensure decisions, actions, risks, and accountabilities are clearly documented.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical audiences at all levels of the organization.

Knowledge Development and Mentoring

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, technicians, molders, and other manufacturing professionals.
  • Build organizational capability by sharing specialized knowledge, developing technical training, and establishing repeatable engineering methods.
  • Review and provide guidance on the technical work of other engineers without serving as their direct manager.
  • Promote disciplined experimentation, fact-based decision making, continuous improvement, and strong engineering practices.
  • Maintain current knowledge of developments in polymer science, molding technology, manufacturing systems, medical-device requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to the development of CONMED’s long-term polymer-processing and manufacturing-technology roadmap.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Polymer Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, or closely related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible engineering experience involving injection molding, polymer processing, plastics manufacturing, tooling, or closely related manufacturing technologies.
  • 2 years of experience applying technical knowledge and expertise troubleshooting injection molded parts noncompliance opportunities to determine whether root cause is part design geometry, raw material, raw material handling, molding process, mold steel dimensions, mold steel wear, mold design conceptualization, molding cell selection, molding cell functional performance, part’s inspection method, inspection fixture, inspection equipment, parts conveying, parts packaging design, parts storing and/or part’s transit related.
  • 2 years of experience leading complex technical projects and influencing decisions across multiple functions. Experience developing or reviewing engineering protocols, validation documents, technical reports, specifications, risk assessments, and process documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or doctorate in Polymer Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Experience in a regulated medical-device, pharmaceutical, life-sciences, automotive, aerospace, or similarly controlled manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with injection molding of medical-device components or other high-precision, high-reliability products.
  • Working knowledge of applicable FDA quality-system requirements, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, good manufacturing practices, and process-validation expectations.
  • Expertise in one or more specialized processes, such as insert molding, overmolding, micro-molding, multi-shot molding, silicone molding, high-temperature materials, or bio-compatible polymers.
  • Experience with mold-flow simulation and analysis tools.
  • Experience with automation, in-mold sensing, process-monitoring systems, machine connectivity, or advanced manufacturing controls.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or structured problem-solving certification.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing transfers, supplier development, capacity expansion, or global operations.
  • Experience working with toolmakers, resin suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and contract manufacturers.
  • Experience with mold design conceptualization, mold manufacturing, mold functional performance testing and mold predictive and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Demonstrated expertise in injection molding process development, optimization, validation and troubleshooting assessment; and in mold design conceptualization, performance testing, plastic forming steel compliance, grooming activities, and troubleshooting assessment.
  • Advanced knowledge of thermoplastic materials, polymer behavior, resin handling, drying, rheology, shrinkage, warpage, degradation, and material-process interactions.
  • Demonstrated experience applying scientific molding principles, design of experiments, statistical analysis, process-capability methods, and structured root-cause analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently define problems, evaluate technical alternatives, and deliver sustainable solutions to highly complex engineering challenges.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and technical documentation skills.



***This position is not eligible for employer based sponsorship***

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Cloud Systems Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Systems Architect

Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 8+ years
Salary - $100k - $150k

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cloud Systems Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end cloud solutions covering compute, networking, storage, identity, data, and observability layers.
  • Lead solution architecture reviews and approval processes for major cloud initiatives.
  • Define cloud landing zone, account structure, and tagging strategies for new and existing workloads.
  • Establish reference architectures, blueprints, and reusable patterns adopted across engineering teams.
  • Architect security, identity, and compliance controls embedded into the cloud foundation.
  • Design networking topologies including VPC/VNet design, transit hubs, hybrid connectivity, and private endpoints.
  • Lead cloud migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives across application portfolios.
  • Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices across the cloud estate, partnering with finance and engineering teams to make cloud spend transparent, predictable, and tied to delivered business value.
  • Partner with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls from the outset.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.
  • Track emerging cloud capabilities and ecosystem developments, assessing relevance to current and planned workloads, and recommend strategic adoption based on demonstrated value and operational maturity.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and regulatory obligations, ensuring that cloud designs satisfy both engineering goals and the broader compliance posture of the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.
  • Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict cloud compliance requirements.
  • Experience driving FinOps and cost transparency initiatives.

description: This project proposes a real-time workflow for 3D X-ray ptychography that uses a sample-specific surrogate model to reduce reconstruction time.

raw.title: Visiting Student - XSD - Koda, Ryota - 10.21.26
raw.excerpt: This project proposes a real-time workflow for 3D X-ray ptychography that uses a sample-specific surrogate model to reduce reconstruction time.
raw.description:
This project proposes a real-time workflow for 3D X-ray ptychography that uses a sample-specific surrogate model to reduce reconstruction time. In 3D ptychography, a sample is illuminated from many angles, and a 2D image is recovered for each angle with iterative phase retrieval (e.g., ePIE) before the images are combined into a 3D volume. Because the phase retrieval is repeated for every direction, it dominates the total runtime. Earlier surrogate-model studies sped up this step but did not evaluate the whole workflow, and they typically required a training dataset prepared in advance. The proposed method instead builds the surrogate model on-the-fly. First, directional subsampling selects a subset of the projection angles. ePIE is run only on those angles, and the resulting diffraction pattern and object image pairs form a small training set. A surrogate model is trained on this set and predicts initial object estimates for the remaining angles. After preprocessing, these predictions initialize a second ePIE pass. The workflow will run on GPUs. Additional work will include the development of a foundation surrogate model for diverse samples and testing other surrogate architectures.

•The entirety of the appointment must be conducted within the United States.

•Must be 18 years or older at the time the appointment begins.

  • Graduated from an accredited institution within the past 3 months; or

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Risk Automation & Intelligence leads the strategy and execution of the data, analytics and automation capabilities that the rest of the Technology Risk and Compliance function relies on to manage risk and demonstrate compliance effectively and efficiently. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK, spanning policy, process, automation and tooling, training and end-user experience for Technology Risk and Compliance capabilities and services.

About the team. Risk Automation and Intelligence is the engine room of the Risk and Compliance function's data and automation, operating as GSK's Risk Operations Centre. The team builds future-ready analytics, automation and intelligence that enable GSK to manage technology risk and compliance proactively and at scale.


Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


  • Set the enterprise vision and multi-year strategy for the data, analytics and automation capabilities that underpin Technology Risk and Compliance at GSK, and secure the investment to deliver it.
  • Lead the Risk Automation & Intelligence organisation, including leaders of teams, and own its capability plan.
  • Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
  • Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators.
  • Own GSK's Cyber Security Policies, ensuring they remain current, practical and aligned with the evolving threat, technology and regulatory landscape.
  • Own the Technology Risk and Compliance processes used across GSK, ensuring they are well-designed, consistently applied and continuously improved.
  • Own the integration between Technology Risk and Compliance and GSK's Enterprise Risk Programme, ensuring technology risk is represented accurately and consistently in enterprise risk reporting and governance.
  • Operate and evolve GSK's Risk Operations Centre model, bringing modern Risk Operations Centre concepts, continuous controls monitoring and quantitative risk analysis into how GSK manages technology risk and compliance.
  • Bring product management rigour to the roadmap for risk and compliance tooling, translating the needs of stakeholders at Director, VP and SVP level into prioritised features and releases.
  • Build and lead the capability that automates risk, control and compliance processes, including AI and intelligent automation, to replace manual effort with proactive, at-scale risk management.
  • Develop risk analytics, models and quantitative risk methods that help the business identify, evaluate and treat cyber risk, and that support prioritisation and inform resource and investment decisions for leadership, ExCom and the Board.
  • Develop performance analytics that measure the effectiveness and operational efficiency of the Technology Risk and Compliance programme itself, driving continuous improvement.
  • Own the data platform and pipelines underpinning risk intelligence, including the tooling used for Board-level Key Risk Indicators, issue and risk management, third-party cyber risk management and software development lifecycle compliance.
  • Own the GRC tooling strategy, including ServiceNow, ensuring the platforms used across GSK for risk and compliance management are modern, well-integrated and fit for purpose.
  • Bring fresh, innovative thinking to how GSK instruments and automates risk and compliance, challenging existing approaches to deliver superior outcomes with less manual effort.
  • Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Why You?
Basic Qualification
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in risk analytics, automation or security data science.
  • Experience building AI and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Product management experience, including applying Agile delivery methods and translating stakeholder requirements into a prioritised roadmap.
  • Experience applying Lean Six Sigma or other process excellence methodologies.
  • Experience delivering data platforms and data pipelines.
  • Experience leading a technical capability.
  • Cyber security experience, including leading a global capability.
  • Experience managing people leaders across multiple geographies.
  • Experience managing a capability budget and vendor portfolio.
  • Experience with quantitative risk analysis and statistical methods.
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership or board-level audiences

Preferred Qualification
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Experience leading a data, analytics or automation capability.
  • Experience with cyber risk quantification methods and associated quantitative risk analysis techniques.
  • Familiarity with modern Risk Operations Centre (ROC) concepts and operating models.
  • Experience with continuous controls monitoring.
  • Familiarity with modern GRC platforms, especially ServiceNow.
  • Cloud data platform experience in Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Relevant certification such as CRISC, CISSP, cloud data or analytics certifications.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Python, SQL, Azure data stack, ServiceNow GRC, Power BI, automation, RPA and AI/intelligent automation tooling.

raw.description:
The Director, Program Management is a strategic leader responsible for driving cross-functional planning, execution, and governance across one or more drug development programs. Partnering closely with Research, Clinical Development, Regulatory, CMC, Quality, and Executive Leadership, this individual will ensure alignment of program strategy, timelines, resources, risks, and key milestones to advance development programs from early-stage research through late-stage development and lifecycle management.

This role requires a deep understanding of cross-functional biopharmaceutical development, exceptional leadership and communication skills, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization to enable timely, informed decision-making.

Responsibilities:

Program Leadership & Execution

  • Lead cross-functional development teams and drive execution of integrated cross-functional program plans across all stages of drug development.
  • Partner with program and functional leaders to align development strategies with corporate objectives and portfolio priorities.
  • Develop and maintain integrated cross-functional development plans, timelines, milestones, assumptions, and critical path analyses.
  • Ensure programs progress efficiently, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities.

Governance & Executive Communication

  • Facilitate program governance, stage-gate reviews, and executive decision-making processes.
  • Develop concise executive-level dashboards, presentations, and recommendations regarding program status, risks, resource needs, and key decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leadership on program execution and portfolio considerations.
  • Promote accountability, alignment, and effective communication across functions and external partners.

Risk, Resource & Portfolio Management

  • Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, scenario analyses, and contingency planning activities.
  • Support resource planning, prioritization, and cross-functional capacity discussions.
  • Drive informed trade-off decisions that balance timelines, cost, quality, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Finance and functional leaders on program forecasting and budget planning activities.

Operational Excellence

  • Champion best practices, tools, and processes that improve program execution, transparency, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance cross-functional collaboration and scalability.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to the ongoing development of Program Management capabilities across the organization.
  • Support strategic initiatives that strengthen and mature the Program Management function.

Qualifications:

Required

  • PhD/Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience, including significant experience leading cross-functional drug development programs.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting programs across multiple stages of development, from early research through clinical development and lifecycle management.
  • Strong understanding of drug development, regulatory processes, and development governance.
  • Proven ability to influence, align, and lead diverse cross-functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience developing integrated project plans, managing risk, and driving strategic decision-making.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent).
  • Oncology development experience.
  • Experience supporting major regulatory milestones, including INDs, CTAs, NDA/BLA submissions, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Experience managing alliances, CROs, CDMOs, and external development partners.
  • Prior experience within a scientific, clinical, regulatory, technical operations, or CMC function.
  • PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • Experience with portfolio planning, resource management, and governance processes.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Programs are delivered with clear alignment to strategic objectives, timelines, and key milestones.

  • Leadership receives timely, transparent, and actionable program insights.
  • Cross-functional teams operate with clarity, accountability, and strong collaboration.
  • Program Management practices continue to evolve and scale with organizational growth.

About Celcuity:

Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. The company's first FDA-approved product is REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), a potent, pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor that comprehensively blockades the PAM pathway. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

The Phase 3 VIKTORIA-2 trial is evaluating gedatolisib in combination with palbociclib and either fulvestrant or letrozole for the first-line treatment of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. A Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer, is ongoing.

Celcuity is an Equal-Opportunity Employer.

The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus and a new hire equity package. Celcuity also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) match, PTO, and paid holidays.

Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies

Let's do this. Let's change the world.

In this vital role, you will join Amgen's Bone Patient Experience team, reporting to the Director of Bone Patient Experience and Access Marketing within Patient Access & Reimbursement (PAR). As a key member of the Patient Experience team, you will serve as a strategic access marketing partner to Brand, Sales, Market Access, and PAR Centers of Excellence (COEs). · Access Tools & Innovation: Lead the development, evaluation, and optimization of access tools across the Bone portfolio, including the Bone Therapy Finder sites, coverage resources, and digital solutions that help our field teams and providers navigate access and reimbursement.
