About TruX Retail Partner
TruX Retail Partner is a retail solutions company built to work differently. We combine experienced people, adaptable solutions, and forward-thinking technology to help retailers solve complex challenges and execute with confidence.

Director of Brand Partnership

The Director of Brand Partnership leads the operational execution and strategic coordination of an assigned client brand, serving as a key liaison between client stakeholders, Program Partnerships, and field operations. This role ensures that staffing, operational priorities, performance expectations, and field execution align with the client's brand objectives and established service requirements.

Through proactive client communication, cross-functional collaboration, and effective performance management, the Director of Brand Partnership strengthens client relationships, promotes consistent execution, and drives measurable program results. This role identifies opportunities to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and brand performance while supporting a people-centered culture grounded in servant leadership, collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to helping employees grow.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead operational planning and execution for assigned client brands, translating client objectives, brand standards, and program requirements into actionable plans, measurable deliverables, and execution priorities.
  • Build and maintain productive client relationships, serving as the primary day-to-day operational contact for assigned brand priorities, performance updates, service needs, and execution concerns.
  • Partner with the Vice President of Program Partnerships, Senior Director of Operations, and corporate functions to align client commitments, operational capacity, staffing needs, and field execution.
  • Coordinate with Operations Managers, supervisors, field associates, and internal teams to communicate priorities, implement brand initiatives, and maintain consistent execution across assigned markets.
  • Monitor brand performance against key performance indicators, service levels, productivity targets, quality standards, and client expectations; identify gaps, coordinate corrective actions, and track results.
  • Analyze operational reports, client feedback, field observations, and performance trends to identify risks, resolve execution challenges, and recommend improvements to service quality and the client experience.
  • Coordinate workforce requirements, staffing priorities, labor allocation, resource utilization, and assigned program expenses with operational leadership to support service commitments and financial objectives.
  • Lead the coordination and rollout of brand programs, promotional activities, merchandising priorities, process changes, and new initiatives in partnership with Operations, Planogram and Floorplan, Innovation, and other relevant functions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop assigned program leaders and team members by establishing clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, and supporting employee engagement and professional growth.
  • Manage brand-related escalations, maintain action plans and client commitments, and provide timely reporting on performance, deliverables, risks, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities; ensure compliance with company policies, contractual obligations, client requirements, and applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in retail operations, client partnership management, field leadership, program execution, or a related field, with demonstrated success delivering client and program outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience coordinating multi-market operations, cross-functional teams, workforce requirements, and brand-specific execution priorities.
  • Demonstrated success monitoring performance metrics, resolving client and operational issues, implementing corrective actions, and improving service quality.
  • Experience monitoring program expenses, supporting labor and resource planning, and identifying opportunities to improve productivity and cost efficiency.
  • Proven ability to manage client relationships, coordinate program initiatives, implement process improvements, and maintain consistent service delivery.
  • Experience with operational reporting, business intelligence platforms, workforce management systems, and project management tools preferred.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, assess risks, exercise sound judgment, and translate client expectations into actionable execution plans.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong operational leadership, strategic planning, and execution skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into measurable field results.
  • Strong client relationship management and program execution skills, with the ability to align brand objectives, client commitments, and operational capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and develop corrective actions.
  • Knowledge of retail operations, merchandising execution, workforce coordination, service quality, and operational performance management.
  • Working knowledge of program expenses, labor utilization, resource allocation, and productivity improvement.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence client stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, track deliverables, and maintain accountability.
  • Ability to resolve client concerns, manage escalations, and balance service expectations with operational and financial requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and develop team members, reinforce accountability, and support professional growth.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, operational reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, project management systems, and other relevant business applications
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive client, personnel, financial, and operational information.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to travel to client meetings, corporate offices, retail locations, and program operations across assigned markets.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds may be required. 

Work Environment

  • Primarily remote within operating market, regular collaboration across corporate teams, field operations, and client locations.
  • Travel to client offices, retail locations, and company meetings as required to support client relationships, operational oversight, strategic initiatives, and program performance.

raw.description:
About Towne

Towne is an exceptional arrival through departure experience company. With its best-in-class parking and hospitality solutions and its fully integrated technology platform, we deliver seamless parking and mobility experiences in the places where people live, learn, work, play, rejuvenate, and recover. Towne’s 14,000 team members create smiles by delivering exceptional experiences for the millions of people we proudly serve each year. For nearly 40 years, Towne has been committed to providing the best experience, delivered by the best team, powered by innovative technology, enhancing lives and communities. For more information, visit and follow us on LinkedIn.

Click here for important notices that may be applicable to you.

For more information about our privacy policy, please click here.

SUMMARY

The Recruiter, Salaried is a strategic partner and expert sourcer for Towne’s salaried and field executive talent, building the hiring plans and market intelligence that put the right leaders in the right roles. This role goes well beyond posting a requisition: it means mapping the market for hard-to-find talent, advising senior leaders with the clarity and confidence of a trusted advisor, and running confidential, high-stakes searches with precision and care. From the first strategic hiring conversation with an executive sponsor to a leader’s final yes, this role turns every search into a Towne Wow moment.

**** MUST BE LOCATED IN CENTRAL OR WEST REGION****


Job Details


Compensation: Towne Park is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location. The annual base pay range for this position is $96,000 - $115,000.


Additional Compensation: Employees may be eligible to receive annual incentive bonuses depending on their job classification and the policy guidelines.


Benefits: Employees are eligible to enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, and telemedicine benefits. Employees are provided company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability. Employees are also able to enroll in the company’s 401k retirement savings plan.


Paid Time Off: Employees accrue 0.0654 hours of PTO per hour worked up to a maximum of 136 hours per calendar year. Employees receive 6 paid holidays throughout the calendar year and employees accrue up to a maximum of 4 paid floating holidays per calendar year.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Strategic Hiring Plans & Business Partnering (25% of time): Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers across functions to build strategic hiring plans for salaried and field executive roles, aligning recruitment approach with business goals.


  • Executive & Salaried Sourcing (30% of time): Proactively source and engage passive and active candidates for salaried and field executive positions using advanced sourcing techniques and market mapping.
  • Full-Cycle Recruitment for Salaried & Executive Roles (20% of time): Manage the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake through offer negotiation and close, for salaried and field executive searches.
  • Market Intelligence & Compensation Benchmarking (10% of time): Research market trends, competitor talent landscapes and compensation benchmarks to advise hiring managers on competitive, well-informed offers and available talent.
  • Candidate & Stakeholder Experience (7% of time): Deliver a high-touch, confidential and consultative experience for candidates and hiring leaders throughout every search.
  • Mentorship & Cross-Team Collaboration (5% of time): Partner with and mentor Recruiters and Sourcers, sharing sourcing strategy and market insight across the team.
  • Recruitment Reporting & Compliance (3% of time): Track and report on salaried and executive recruiting metrics and ensure all recruitment activity complies with employment law and Towne policy.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • High School Diploma

Required Licensure, Certification, etc.:

  • No specific licensure or certification is required for this role.
  • PHR, SHRM-CP, or AIRS/CIR recruiting certification is preferred, though not required.

Work Experience:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience recruiting for salaried, exempt-level or executive roles, ideally within hospitality, healthcare, commercial real estate or another multi-site service industry.
  • Demonstrated experience building strategic hiring plans and executive-level sourcing strategies in partnership with senior business leaders strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills:

Advanced sourcing and market-mapping skills, with the proven ability to act as a trusted strategic partner to senior business leaders on salaried and field executive hiring.

  • Advanced sourcing expertise, including Boolean and X-ray search, market mapping and competitive intelligence, to identify hard-to-find salaried and executive talent.
  • Ability to build and present strategic hiring plans that align sourcing approach, timeline and market strategy to a role’s level of complexity and confidentiality.
  • Strong compensation acumen, including the ability to benchmark salaried and executive offers against market data and advise leaders accordingly.
  • Executive-level communication, negotiation and consultative skills; comfortable advising senior leaders and closing complex offers.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and advanced sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, and executive search databases.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and compliance requirements, including EEO, ADA and FLSA.

SCOPE

Authority to Act:

Performs duties with little direction given, operating from established directions and instructions. Decisions are made within general Town Parke policy constraints but occasionally require independent decision making.

Budget Responsibility:

The employee has control over resources available only.


WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit or stand for extended periods of time and may be required to run; walk; handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Lifting Requirements

Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

.

Working Environment

The majority of work will be performed in climate-controlled environment, but may be exposed to inclement weather and varying degrees of temperatures on occasion.

Travel

  • Travel of up to 20% may be required.

raw.title: Senior Robotics Technical Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: Role overviewBerkshire Grey is hiring a Sr Robotics Technical Support Engineer to provide advanced support during commissioning and 24/7 customer operations.
raw.description:
Role overview

Berkshire Grey is hiring a Sr Robotics Technical Support Engineer to provide advanced support during commissioning and 24/7 customer operations. This role diagnoses complex issues across robotic hardware, software, controls, Linux, and networks, and serves as the senior escalation point for the rest of the support team.

The engineer partners with Engineering and service teams to restore operations and prevent recurring failures. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting, small software projects, and AI agent interactions with clear customer communication, incident leadership, and accountability for reliable results.

Key responsibilities

  • Diagnose complex failures across robotic hardware, software, controls, Linux, and networks.
  • Analyze logs, telemetry, and system data to recreate failures and establish root causes.
  • Troubleshoot sensors, cameras, actuators, conveyor systems, PLC/HMI interfaces, and calibrations.
  • Develop API integrations and automated support workflows.
  • Use GitHub and approved release processes for software changes.
  • Use AI agents for diagnostics, data analysis, scripting, knowledge retrieval, and documentation.
  • Validate AI outputs, troubleshoot agent interactions, and protect customer data.
  • Lead high-severity incident calls, coordinate responders, and verify recovery with customers.
  • Manage Salesforce cases and Jira issues with timely updates, clear ownership, and complete evidence.
  • Partner with Program and Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success teams on technical risks and customer improvement.
  • Coordinate Support, Field Services, and Deployment through commissioning and support handover.
  • Coordinate safe recovery, field work orders, parts replacement and replenishment, and corrective actions through completion.
  • Communicate technical findings, customer impact, and next steps to customers and leadership.
  • Improve restoration times, customer experience, and reliability through measurable corrective actions.
  • Mentor engineers and maintain knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, and runbooks.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Robotics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience; 3+ years resolving complex robotics or automation issues in a customer-facing role.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and robotic hardware diagnostic skills.
  • Network diagnostics across TCP/IP, switching, routing, VLANs, DNS, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Programming or scripting in Python, Bash, C++, Java, or similar languages; experience with GitHub.
  • Experience with databases, SQL, log analysis, APIs, and AI agents or coding assistants.
  • Kubernetes cluster management experience.
  • Proven escalation ownership and sustained collaboration across engineering and service teams.
  • Clear communication with customers, executives, and nontechnical stakeholders under pressure.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and prioritization in ambiguous, urgent situations.

Preferred experience

  • 3+ years leading technical incident calls or managing major incidents.
  • Salesforce and Jira case management.
  • MacTalk or similar motor commissioning tool.
  • Studio 5000 Logix Designer or similar PLC programming and configuration software.
  • Cloud infrastructure, virtual networks, compute, storage, messaging, and serverless automation.
  • Computer vision, machine learning, motion planning, containers, and AI agent integrations.

Travel

  • Less than 5% expected; may reach 20% or higher during training.

5120-2603HN

Salary: Base salary range $80k-$110k

About Towne

Towne is an exceptional arrival through departure experience company. With its best-in-class parking and hospitality solutions and its fully integrated technology platform, we deliver seamless parking and mobility experiences in the places where people live, learn, work, play, rejuvenate, and recover. Towne’s 14,000 team members create smiles by delivering exceptional experiences for the millions of people we proudly serve each year. For nearly 40 years, Towne has been committed to providing the best experience, delivered by the best team, powered by innovative technology, enhancing lives and communities. For more information, visit and follow us on LinkedIn.

Click here for important notices that may be applicable to you.

For more information about our privacy policy, please click here.

SUMMARY

The Recruiter, Salaried is a strategic partner and expert sourcer for Towne’s salaried and field executive talent, building the hiring plans and market intelligence that put the right leaders in the right roles. This role goes well beyond posting a requisition: it means mapping the market for hard-to-find talent, advising senior leaders with the clarity and confidence of a trusted advisor, and running confidential, high-stakes searches with precision and care. From the first strategic hiring conversation with an executive sponsor to a leader’s final yes, this role turns every search into a Towne Wow moment.

**** MUST BE LOCATED IN CENTRAL OR WEST REGION****


Job Details


Compensation: Towne Park is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location. The annual base pay range for this position is $96,000 - $115,000.


Additional Compensation: Employees may be eligible to receive annual incentive bonuses depending on their job classification and the policy guidelines.


Benefits: Employees are eligible to enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, and telemedicine benefits. Employees are provided company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability. Employees are also able to enroll in the company’s 401k retirement savings plan.


Paid Time Off: Employees accrue 0.0654 hours of PTO per hour worked up to a maximum of 136 hours per calendar year. Employees receive 6 paid holidays throughout the calendar year and employees accrue up to a maximum of 4 paid floating holidays per calendar year.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Strategic Hiring Plans & Business Partnering (25% of time): Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers across functions to build strategic hiring plans for salaried and field executive roles, aligning recruitment approach with business goals.


  • Executive & Salaried Sourcing (30% of time): Proactively source and engage passive and active candidates for salaried and field executive positions using advanced sourcing techniques and market mapping.
  • Full-Cycle Recruitment for Salaried & Executive Roles (20% of time): Manage the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake through offer negotiation and close, for salaried and field executive searches.
  • Market Intelligence & Compensation Benchmarking (10% of time): Research market trends, competitor talent landscapes and compensation benchmarks to advise hiring managers on competitive, well-informed offers and available talent.
  • Candidate & Stakeholder Experience (7% of time): Deliver a high-touch, confidential and consultative experience for candidates and hiring leaders throughout every search.
  • Mentorship & Cross-Team Collaboration (5% of time): Partner with and mentor Recruiters and Sourcers, sharing sourcing strategy and market insight across the team.
  • Recruitment Reporting & Compliance (3% of time): Track and report on salaried and executive recruiting metrics and ensure all recruitment activity complies with employment law and Towne policy.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • High School Diploma

Required Licensure, Certification, etc.:

  • No specific licensure or certification is required for this role.
  • PHR, SHRM-CP, or AIRS/CIR recruiting certification is preferred, though not required.

Work Experience:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience recruiting for salaried, exempt-level or executive roles, ideally within hospitality, healthcare, commercial real estate or another multi-site service industry.
  • Demonstrated experience building strategic hiring plans and executive-level sourcing strategies in partnership with senior business leaders strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills:

Advanced sourcing and market-mapping skills, with the proven ability to act as a trusted strategic partner to senior business leaders on salaried and field executive hiring.

  • Advanced sourcing expertise, including Boolean and X-ray search, market mapping and competitive intelligence, to identify hard-to-find salaried and executive talent.
  • Ability to build and present strategic hiring plans that align sourcing approach, timeline and market strategy to a role’s level of complexity and confidentiality.
  • Strong compensation acumen, including the ability to benchmark salaried and executive offers against market data and advise leaders accordingly.
  • Executive-level communication, negotiation and consultative skills; comfortable advising senior leaders and closing complex offers.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and advanced sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, and executive search databases.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and compliance requirements, including EEO, ADA and FLSA.

SCOPE

Authority to Act:

Performs duties with little direction given, operating from established directions and instructions. Decisions are made within general Town Parke policy constraints but occasionally require independent decision making.

Budget Responsibility:

The employee has control over resources available only.


WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit or stand for extended periods of time and may be required to run; walk; handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Lifting Requirements

Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Working Environment

The majority of work will be performed in climate-controlled environment, but may be exposed to inclement weather and varying degrees of temperatures on occasion.

Travel

Role overview

Berkshire Grey is hiring a Sr Robotics Technical Support Engineer to provide advanced support during commissioning and 24/7 customer operations. This role diagnoses complex issues across robotic hardware, software, controls, Linux, and networks, and serves as the senior escalation point for the rest of the support team.

The engineer partners with Engineering and service teams to restore operations and prevent recurring failures. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting, small software projects, and AI agent interactions with clear customer communication, incident leadership, and accountability for reliable results.

Key responsibilities

  • Diagnose complex failures across robotic hardware, software, controls, Linux, and networks.
  • Analyze logs, telemetry, and system data to recreate failures and establish root causes.
  • Troubleshoot sensors, cameras, actuators, conveyor systems, PLC/HMI interfaces, and calibrations.
  • Develop API integrations and automated support workflows.
  • Use GitHub and approved release processes for software changes.
  • Use AI agents for diagnostics, data analysis, scripting, knowledge retrieval, and documentation.
  • Validate AI outputs, troubleshoot agent interactions, and protect customer data.
  • Lead high-severity incident calls, coordinate responders, and verify recovery with customers.
  • Manage Salesforce cases and Jira issues with timely updates, clear ownership, and complete evidence.
  • Partner with Program and Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success teams on technical risks and customer improvement.
  • Coordinate Support, Field Services, and Deployment through commissioning and support handover.
  • Coordinate safe recovery, field work orders, parts replacement and replenishment, and corrective actions through completion.
  • Communicate technical findings, customer impact, and next steps to customers and leadership.
  • Improve restoration times, customer experience, and reliability through measurable corrective actions.
  • Mentor engineers and maintain knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, and runbooks.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Robotics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience; 3+ years resolving complex robotics or automation issues in a customer-facing role.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration and robotic hardware diagnostic skills.
  • Network diagnostics across TCP/IP, switching, routing, VLANs, DNS, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Programming or scripting in Python, Bash, C++, Java, or similar languages; experience with GitHub.
  • Experience with databases, SQL, log analysis, APIs, and AI agents or coding assistants.
  • Kubernetes cluster management experience.
  • Proven escalation ownership and sustained collaboration across engineering and service teams.
  • Clear communication with customers, executives, and nontechnical stakeholders under pressure.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and prioritization in ambiguous, urgent situations.

Preferred experience

  • 3+ years leading technical incident calls or managing major incidents.
  • Salesforce and Jira case management.
  • MacTalk or similar motor commissioning tool.
  • Studio 5000 Logix Designer or similar PLC programming and configuration software.
  • Cloud infrastructure, virtual networks, compute, storage, messaging, and serverless automation.
  • Computer vision, machine learning, motion planning, containers, and AI agent integrations.

Travel

  • Less than 5% expected; may reach 20% or higher during training.

PREFERRED SKILLS, EDUCATION, AND EXPERIENCE

At Ascend Technologies we firmly believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not only fundamental values but also powerful drivers of innovation, growth, and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

About the Role:

Panorama is reimagining how we implement our products for clients, and the Director, Implementation will lead that transformation while running the Implementation function day to day. You’ll move the team from a transactional, ticket-oriented model toward an experience designed around getting clients launched quickly and positioned to realize value from Panorama. This is both an operating and transformation mandate: you’ll lead the team, redesign its processes and tooling, strengthen cross-functional handoffs, and build an implementation experience that works backward from the outcomes clients are trying to achieve. You’ll report to the Vice President, Adoption & Services and lead a team of 12, with members located in the United States and Mexico.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Implementation function end to end, including its operating model, team staffing and performance (including hiring and capacity planning), processes, tooling, cross-functional handoffs, launch speed, and client implementation experience (including escalated client issues).
  • Transform implementation around speed and client outcomes, with goals of:
    • Reducing average implementation time from six weeks to three weeks for Surveys, Student Success, and Solara, and from 14 weeks to seven weeks for Panorama Pathways (speed)
    • Reducing current rates of fixes required to integrations and configuration after a client goes live in the platform (quality)
    • Reducing time to first value for clients as measured by our use case health model (TTV)
  • Redesign the client implementation experience to reduce cumbersome back-and-forth and use synchronous collaboration—including live conversations and, when appropriate, onsite work—to resolve issues and accelerate progress.
  • Align implementation services with the broader client value-delivery model, configuring the platform in support of the priorities, outcomes, and workflows established with each client by Panorama team members in other roles (Sales, Account Management, Project Management, Solutions Architecture).
  • Maintain clear, current visibility into the status of every active implementation for cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Account Management, Project Management, and Teaching & Learning; proactively surface risks, dependencies, and emerging challenges that could jeopardize client milestones or outcomes, and drive action early enough to prevent avoidable breakdowns.
  • Make Implementation a seamless part of Panorama’s broader client value-delivery model, configuring the platform in support of the priorities, outcomes, and workflows established with each client in partnership with leaders in Product and Engineering.
  • Reimagine Implementation’s processes and tooling, including applying AI and first-principles thinking to improve how the work gets done.
  • Lead and develop the Implementation team through significant change, including building an effective team-lead structure that strengthens day-to-day leadership and develops additional leadership capacity.

Requirements

  • Experience leading a services team in a SaaS environment, with direct responsibility for team performance and business outcomes. Implementation leadership experience is preferred, though closely related services functions such as training or custom development may provide relevant experience.
  • Personal experience doing implementation work and the functional depth to lead practitioners, diagnose problems, and redesign the work without needing to learn the fundamentals of implementation on the job.
  • Strong technical acumen and demonstrated ability to use technology—including AI—to improve or transform operational processes relevant to the implementation of enterprise SaaS applications (including platform integration, data transformation, solution architecture, ticket management, and workflow design and optimization).
  • Experience leading a complex team through meaningful operational or organizational change.
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business and client problems into clear priorities, operating decisions, and action across teams.
  • Experience in K–12 SaaS edtech services or support (including familiarity with the K12 leadership structures and practices, the K12 IT stack, and applicable data security and privacy regulations) is strongly preferred, but not required.

Benefits

Base Salary: The base salary range for this position is $143,650 - $211,250. Our salary is just one component of Panorama’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual bonuses or commission awards, equity awards, as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits

About Panorama:

Panorama Education is a technology company building the leading platform for student insight and action in K-12. We help modern school systems understand what students need and take effective action. By bringing together academics, attendance, behavior, and engagement data with AI, we give educators the full picture of every student and the intelligence to decide what to do next. As a mission-driven company supporting 15 million students in 2,000 districts nationwide, the work we do has a direct line to student outcomes every day. Join us and help shape what education looks like for the next generation.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Deal Desk Sr. Analyst to own Panorama's deal desk process from quote through booking. Operating within the Finance organization, this role will be the go-to resource for sales on deal structure and will work cross-functionally with RevOps, Legal, and Accounting to build the processes and best practices that help us scale without slowing the sales process.

As part of a lean team, you will be expected to manage Deal Desk and take ownership of new projects as assigned. This position is especially suited for someone looking to expand their Deal Desk foundations into deeper GTM or financial analysis.

Panorama is here to improve education for every student, and this role gives you a direct opportunity to help our commercial teams bring our products to more schools and districts. We serve more than 15 million students across all 50 states, and as we continue to grow, we need scalable processes that allow us to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for accuracy and thoughtful decision-making.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Own the deal desk and order management process

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Sales and Account Management on deal structure, pricing, quoting, and approvals across new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
  • Structure, review, and process deals based on established commercial standards, with special attention towards non-standard requests (e.g. discounts, payment terms, multi-year structures), balancing customer needs with Panorama's pricing and commercial policies.
  • Maintain the sources of truth for deal requirements, sales templates, and approval matrices, establishing greater accuracy and consistency within the sales motion.
  • Review all closed deals, amendments, and cancellations for completeness and accuracy within Salesforce, enabling streamlined processing by billing teams.

Cross-functional partnerships

  • Partner cross-functionally with RevOps on Salesforce, CPQ, and operational implications; Finance on pricing and discounting; and Legal on non-standard terms to ensure aligned decision-making with the appropriate approval authority.
  • Build trusted relationships across functions and become a go-to resource for commercial processes, promoting faster decision-making and a smoother path from deal development through close.

Drive continuous improvement

  • Analyze deal data to identify trends in discounting, structures, and approval patterns, surfacing insights that improve pricing decisions and commercial policy.
  • Identify opportunities to automate or simplify processes, improve deal turnaround time and accuracy, and reduce operational friction.
  • Develop enablement materials and support Sales training on deal desk processes and best practices, increasing Sales self-sufficiency and driving consistent execution.

What You Bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, RevOps, Legal, and other functions.

About the Role We are building a next-generation AI-driven anti-cheating system for competitive strategy games.
Unlike traditional fraud detection, our challenge sits at the intersection of:

  • 🎮 Game AI & player behavior modeling
  • 🧠 Reinforcement learning & decision systems
  • 🔍 Anomaly detection under adversarial conditions

You will work on identifying non-obvious, strategic cheating behaviors in complex environments where players actively adapt to detection systems. This is not rule-based detection — this is behavioral intelligence at scale.


What You’ll Do 1️⃣ Behavioral Modeling & Detection

  • Design machine learning / deep learning models to detect cheating patterns
  • Model player behavior sequences, strategies, and anomalies
  • Build systems that distinguish:
  • high-skill play vs. AI-assisted play
  • natural variance vs. exploitation

2️⃣ Anti-Cheating System Design

  • Develop scalable detection pipelines (offline + real-time)
  • Build feature systems from gameplay logs / event streams
  • Design evaluation frameworks for detection accuracy & robustness

3️⃣ ML / DL / Advanced Techniques

  • Apply and experiment with:
  • sequence modeling (RNN / Transformer-based)
  • anomaly detection
  • graph-based or behavioral embeddings
  • Explore intersections with:
  • reinforcement learning
  • game-theoretic modeling
  • adversarial ML

4️⃣ Collaboration with AI & Engineering Teams

  • Work closely with:
  • Gameplay AI / RL researchers
  • Backend / data engineering teams
  • Translate models into production systems

What We’re Looking For

✅ Core Requirements

  • 4+ years in Data Science / Machine Learning roles
  • Strong foundation in:
  • deep learning
  • statistical modeling
  • Experience in one or more of:
  • fraud detection / AML
  • risk modeling
  • anomaly detection
  • behavioral analytics

✅ Strong Signals (Big Plus)

  • Experience with:
  • sequence models (LSTM / Transformer)
  • large-scale behavioral data
  • real-time detection systems
  • Exposure to:
  • reinforcement learning
  • game AI
  • adversarial systems

✅ Technical Stack

  • Python (must)
  • PyTorch / TensorFlow
  • SQL / data pipelines
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets

Why This Role is Interesting

  • 🚀 Work on problems similar to fraud detection at scale — but harder
  • 🎯 Direct impact on real-money / competitive environments
  • 🧠 Blend of:
  • ML research
  • production systems
  • game AI
  • 🌍 Fully remote, globally distributed team

Location & Visa

  • 🌏 Remote-first (global team)
  • 🇯🇵 Japan relocation supported (visa sponsorship available for qualified candidates)

Who This Role is Perfect For

  • Data scientists bored with “dashboard ML”
  • Fraud / AML experts who want more complex, adversarial systems
  • ML engineers who want to work closer to decision intelligence & behavior modeling

Element develops a sovereign, interoperable and secure communications platform for government, defence and public sector organisations.

We are a for-profit company committed to open source, building on Matrix; the open communication standard created by the same team behind Element.
Element works closely with organisations including the NATO, United Nations, and more than 35 governments to provide sovereign workplace solutions for public administration.

We are building something important for highly regulated and security-sensitive environments, and we cannot do that without a diverse and high-performing team. Our hiring process is designed to be respectful, transparent and fair.

Our Values.
  • We care about the greater good
  • We work together in the open
  • We are proud of how we serve our customers
  • We are ambitious and iterate rapidly

About you.

What we're looking for.
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Commercial Recruitment within the SaaS/Open Source sector.
  • Strong experience recruiting across commercial functions such as Sales, Marketing, Customer Success or Product, as well as technical hiring when needed.
  • Experience designing, implementing or continuously improving recruitment processes, frameworks and hiring practices, with a focus on consistency, efficiency and quality of hire.
  • Strong existing network within the software, SaaS or B2B technology sector, with demonstrated ability to identify and engage passive candidates through professional communities, referrals, direct sourcing and personal networks.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and influencing hiring managers on recruitment best practice, including role definition, sourcing strategies, interviewing, structured assessment and effective decision-making.
  • Strong interviewing skills focusing on delivering an exceptional candidate experience with the ability to influence hiring decisions.
  • Practical experience applying inclusive recruitment practices and helping hiring managers recognise and reduce bias throughout the recruitment process, including job design, sourcing, interviewing and candidate assessment.
  • Experience using recruitment data and candidate feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and measure the effectiveness of recruitment processes.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple countries and time zones.

Bonus points if you also have:
  • Experience working in remote first companies.
  • Experience using Bob Hiring/HiBob.
  • Experience in the government/defence sector
  • French or German language skills.

About the role.

The impact you’ll make.
We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Acquisition Specialist to join Element for 6 months and help us deliver our global hiring plans efficiently and consistently.

This role is super exciting as we continue to scale our recruitment capability. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day recruitment delivery across a range of global roles, partnering closely with hiring managers from role briefing through to offer and onboarding.

You’ll also play an essential part in helping us get the most from our recently implemented recruitment framework and Bob Hiring ATS. This includes helping hiring managers use the process effectively, identifying opportunities to simplify and improve how we recruit, and making sure our systems, processes and data support a great experience for candidates and hiring teams.

Over your six months with us, you’ll help us build a stronger recruitment processes, better hiring-manager capability and a well-maintained ATS:
  • Create a great candidate experience from first contact through to joining Element
  • Deliver our global recruitment plans efficiently and in timely manner
  • Embed our recruitment framework and ways of working across the business
  • Coach hiring managers to become confident and consistent with good recruitment practice
  • Optimise Bob Hiring so that it supports, rather than slows down, our recruitment process
  • Identify and implement practical improvements to our recruitment processes, templates and workflows
  • Bring useful market insight and sourcing expertise to hard-to-fill roles


What you’ll be doing.
  • Recruitment Operations
    • Review and enhance recruitment processes, templates and documentation to ensure they remain efficient, scalable and aligned with business needs.
    • Maintain accurate recruitment data, candidate records and interview documentation within our ATS, Bob Hiring.
    • Review and optimise Bob Hiring, including workflows, templates, automations, candidate stages and data quality.
    • Monitor recruitment metrics and use them to identify trends, bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.

  • Recruitment Delivery
    • Lead the end to end recruitment process for positions across commercial, product and technical teams, adapting your approach to different hiring needs and business priorities.
    • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define recruitment strategies and identify the skills and behaviours needed for success.
    • Source, engage and attract high quality candidates through job adverts, job boards, professional networks, referrals, recruitment events and any other sourcing channels.
    • Screen applications, conduct interviews and manage candidate assessments to ensure a consistent, fair and effective recruitment process.
    • Manage offers and support successful candidates through pre employment checks and onboarding.
    • Deliver an outstanding candidate experience that reflects Element's values and employer brand.

  • Partnership and Capability Building
    • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and partner with them throughout the hiring process.
    • Coach and support hiring managers on interviewing techniques, structured assessments, fair, unbiased and inclusive hiring practices and market insights.
    • Champion diversity, equity and inclusion by promoting fair, objective and consistent recruitment practices.
    • Help hiring managers use the recruitment framework consistently and provide practical guidance on candidate markets, sourcing challenges and recruitment timelines

About joining Element.

Salary Range.
Annual salary range: £45,000 - £55,000 (FTE - will be pro rata depending on the length of the contract)

Please note, this role is advertised fully remote in Europe (inc. UK), the salary will be benchmarked to your local market and may differ from the range above. The specific salary applicable to your location will be shared with you at the first stage of the recruitment process.

Where we're located.
We are a fully remote Team and this role is open to candidates based in any these countries: Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship at this time, so you'll need to have the relevant right to work in on of those countries.

raw.excerpt: YCP is a Singapore-based advisory and investment firm listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
raw.description:
YCP is a Singapore-based advisory and investment firm listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Founded in 2011, the Group has achieved exponential growth and now has 700+ professionals across 20+ offices globally, including China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Netherlands, Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, USA, and Vietnam. Our advisory arm focuses on consulting engagements related to new business development, business turnaround, financial advisory including M&A due diligence, digital marketing, and global expansion support. Our investment arm operates businesses in personal care, F&B, early education, pet care and other strategic sectors across Asia. Please visit for more details.

About the role

We are looking for a Legal Counsel (Associate level) to join YCP's Group Legal and Compliance Division. We are a lean team of five to six lawyers, made up of Group-level counsel and regional counsel across our key markets. Reporting to the Group Legal Officer, Director of Legal & Compliance Division, you will work on Group-level legal matters across our global operations, including M&A, governance, compliance and complex commercial work, and partner closely with regional counsel and the business.

This is a broad, hands-on role for a corporate commercial lawyer who wants to grow into a well-rounded in-house counsel. You will get early exposure to strategic matters and work directly with senior management.

Key responsibilities

Working closely with the Group Legal Officer, Director of Legal & Compliance Division, you will take on progressively greater ownership across the following areas. You will lead selected workstreams independently, with guidance and support on more complex matters.

1. M&A & Corporate Transactions

﻿

  • Support the Group's acquisitions, mergers, investments, divestments, joint ventures, internal restructurings, and winding-up, including post-merger integration and earn-out matters.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate transaction documents, including share purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements, subscription agreements, and ancillary documents.
  • Assist with legal due diligence, and prepare issues lists and risk summaries for management.
  • Manage external counsel engagement, including scoping, fee proposals, and invoice review.
  • Manage closing checklists, conditions precedent and post-completion obligations.

2. Group Governance & Policy

﻿

  • Draft, review, update, and roll out Group-level policies, and review proposed local-level policies for consistency with the Group framework.
  • Support maintenance of the Group's Delegation of Authority.
  • Support governance and disclosure matters relevant to the Group's status as a Tokyo Stock Exchange-listed company, in coordination with the Group's Investor Relations team.
  • Keep track of relevant legal and regulatory developments and assess their impact on the Group.

3. Compliance

﻿

  • Support the design and implementation of the Group's compliance framework, including risk assessments, annual compliance training, new joiner compliance trainings, Compliance Committee meetings, reporting, and monitoring.
  • Advise on regulatory requirements across key operating jurisdictions, including corporate, employment, data privacy, anti-bribery and corruption, insider dealing, and AML/KYC, in coordination with local teams.
  • Liaise with local teams on regulatory developments and escalate relevant changes as necessary.
  • Support internal investigations and compliance reviews as required.
  • Maintain the compliance incident register and prepare incident reports.

4. Corporate Secretarial

﻿

  • Support corporate secretarial matters of Group holding entity in Singapore, in coordination with its external company secretary.
  • Oversee corporate secretarial matters across YCP entities, including resolutions, minutes, and statutory filings in coordination with finance teams and external company secretaries in each jurisdiction.
  • Maintain an up-to-date register of Group entities, directors and authorised signatories.

5. Employment

﻿

  • Advise HR on Group-level and cross-border employment matters, including senior hires, terminations, disciplinary matters and employee relations.
  • Review and maintain the Group's employment contract templates and offer letters, and support standardisation across Group entities.
  • Coordinate with regional counsel and local external counsel on jurisdiction-specific employment matters, providing Group-level oversight and consistency.
  • Support workplace policies and employment compliance, including anti-harassment frameworks, in coordination with HR.

6. Contracting

﻿

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements entered into by the Group holding entity, including vendor engagement letters, NDAs, and data processing agreements.
  • Review third-party technology and AI tools from a legal, confidentiality and data protection perspective.
  • Advise local teams on complex or novel contractual matters escalated to Group Legal & Compliance Division, including contractual risk, liability positions, and negotiation strategy.
  • Develop, maintain and improve Group contract templates and playbooks to enable consistent, efficient contracting across offices.

7. Legal Operations

﻿

  • Support the development of legal processes, tools, and knowledge management to improve efficiency across the function.
  • Maintain the Group holding entity's contract repository.
  • Oversee adherence to the Group's contract repository and matter tracking processes by other Group entities, in coordination with regional counsel.

8. Disputes

﻿

  • Support pre-litigation matters, claims, and commercial disputes, including demand letters, settlement negotiations, and case documentation.
  • Support the Group's dispute counsel in instructing and coordinating with external counsel on litigation and arbitration matters, including managing timelines and costs.

Why join us

  • Flexible working. Work remotely, with access to our office at Oval Damansara anytime.
  • Help build the function. Our legal function is still taking shape, so you will help set the standards, frameworks and ways of working for the whole Group, rather than inheriting them.
  • A genuine step up. Work on Group-level M&A, governance and strategic matters, with guidance from the Group Legal Officer.
  • Breadth you won't get in private practice. Gain exposure across corporate, compliance, employment and disputes in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Room to innovate. Shape how the function uses legal technology and AI, from contract templates to process automation.
  • Direct access to leadership. Work closely with senior management on matters that affect the business.

Qualifications & requirements

  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB) from a reputable university, or an equivalent legal qualification; admitted as an Advocate & Solicitor of the High Court of Malaya (or equivalent qualification in a Commonwealth jurisdiction).
  • 4 – 6 years of post-qualification experience in corporate, M&A or corporate commercial practice, including experience at a reputable law firm. In-house experience is an advantage.
  • Experience in M&A and corporate transactions, and commercial contracting.
  • Exposure to compliance, corporate governance, and employment matters is highly advantageous. Exposure to disputes matters is advantageous.
  • Strong drafting, analytical, and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate legal issues into clear, practical business advice.
  • Commercially aware, able to balance legal risk with business objectives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple matters and deadlines independently.
  • Sound judgement and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.
  • Comfortable working with legal technology and AI tools, and keen to improve how the function works.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia is expected. Mandarin or Japanese is a plus.

The Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for advancing quality engineering practices across a defined portion of Humana’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Quality Engineering – Segment, this role will lead teams responsible for delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement across multiple product and application teams.

This leader will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality partners to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability.

raw.description:
Job Overview:

The Hosting Architect will lead Fortrea’s enterprise transition from on premises datacenters to Hyperscaler, delivering a modern, resilient, and automated hosting platform that accelerates application delivery and business innovation. This role owns the target state Azure and hybrid hosting architecture, governs large scale cloud migration, and modernizes operations through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and AI driven operations. The objective is to increase speed to market, reduce operational friction, improve resiliency, and lower total cost of ownership. This is a hands-on senior architecture role with accountability for measurable business and operational outcomes, operating in a regulated enterprise environment.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Cloud Migration & Hybrid Architecture

  • Define and own Fortrea’s target‑state Cloud hosting architecture aligned to business and technology strategy.
  • Design and govern hybrid architectures during phased migration from on‑premises to Cloud.
  • Lead workload migration strategies (rehost, re‑platform, refactor, retire) to balance speed, risk, and value.
  • Act as the architectural authority for hosting and Cloud migration decisions.

Cloud Platform & Cloud‑Native Enablement

  • Architect Cloud platforms including landing zones, identity, networking, security, HA, and DR.
  • Establish standardised Cloud reference architectures and blueprints to accelerate application onboarding.
  • Enable self‑service, repeatable platforms that reduce delivery lead time for application and product teams.
  • Drive adoption of cloud‑native services to simplify operations and improve scalability and cost efficiency.

Automation, IaC & AI‑Led Operations

  • Implement an automation‑first operating model across hybrid and Cloud environments.
  • Build and govern Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Introduce AIOps and intelligent automation for predictive monitoring, self‑healing, and faster incident resolution.
  • Reduce environment provisioning time, manual effort, and operational cost through standardisation and automation.

Operational Excellence, Resilience & Governance

  • Embed resiliency, observability, and reliability engineering into all hosting designs.
  • Improve platform availability, reduce incidents, and optimise recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).
  • Ensure hosting platforms meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide architectural leadership across infrastructure, application, security, and compliance teams.

Value & Outcomes

The Hosting Architect is accountable for delivering:

  • Faster and safer Cloud migration at enterprise scale.
  • Reduced time‑to‑provision and change lead times for applications.
  • Improved platform reliability, availability, and recovery performance.
  • Measurable reduction in hosting OPEX through automation and cloud optimisation.
  • Hosting platforms that accelerate business capability delivery, not constrain it.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to present complex architectural concepts to senior leadership, technical teams, and non‑technical stakeholders.

Required skills (Minimum Required):

Core Experience

  • 10+ years in hosting, infrastructure, or cloud architecture roles.
  • Proven leadership of large‑scale Cloud migration programs.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise datacentre technologies and hybrid architectures.

Cloud & Cloud Expertise

  • Deep hands‑on experience with Cloud compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
  • Experience designing hybrid connectivity and phased migration strategies.
  • Cloud architecture and/or security certifications preferred.

Automation & AI

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code and scripting.
  • Exposure to AIOps or intelligent automation platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in reducing operational effort and cost through automation.

Professional Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑influencing skills.
  • Comfortable operating in complex, regulated enterprise environments.
  • Outcome‑driven mindset with a focus on business value and execution speed.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent professional experience in lieu of formal educational requirements.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

  • Remote-Based, as requested by the line manager

  • Work Timings: 2:00 PM IST to 11.00 PM IST

  • Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

DUAL North America is seeking an AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management to lead enterprise technology delivery, release governance, and strategic project execution across the organization. This role requires a strong leader who can drive the successful planning, coordination, communication, and delivery of technology initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

The AVP will oversee a team of product owners, analysts and project professionals, manage complex cross-functional technology programs, establish release management best practices, and partner closely with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable solutions that support operational excellence and business growth.

Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for requirements management, release management, and project execution.

Release Management and Governance

  • Own and mature the enterprise release management function, including release planning, scheduling, governance, risk management, and deployment readiness.

  • Establish standardized release management processes, controls, and reporting to improve delivery predictability and quality.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of technology releases across applications, infrastructure, and business systems.

Release Communications and Stakeholder Engagement

Technical Requirements Management

  • Lead the gathering, prioritization, and validation of technical and functional requirements for strategic technology initiatives.

  • Collaborate with architects, engineers and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are clearly defined and actionable.

  • Establish best practices for requirements management to improve solution quality, reduce rework, and accelerate delivery.

  • Ensure technical requirements align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and business objectives.

Project and Program Management

  • Lead complex technology projects and programs from initiation through implementation and operational transition.

  • Ensure delivery teams maintain alignment with scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business goals.

  • Drive cross-functional coordination to remove obstacles, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum.

  • Utilize SAFe Agile 6.0, and traditional project delivery methodologies as appropriate to maximize successful outcomes.

Data-Driven Delivery Excellence

  • Leverage reporting and analytics to monitor progress, identify risks, and support executive decision-making.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on performance trends and lessons learned.

Change Leadership and Organizational Readiness

  • Support organizational readiness activities that support successful adoption of new technology solutions and capabilities.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between project delivery objectives and operational execution.

  • Promote best practices that improve delivery efficiency, team effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology delivery, project/program management, release management, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.

  • PMP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Release Train Engineer (RTE), or equivalent certifications preferred.

  • Experience implementing enterprise release management frameworks and governance models preferred.

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale technology programs, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional delivery teams.

  • Demonstrated expertise in Release Management, Project Management, and Technical Requirements Management within complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong knowledge of Agile SAFe 6, and traditional project management methodologies.

  • Proven success managing technology portfolios, release governance processes, and organizational transformation initiatives.

  • Experience working closely with architecture, engineering, infrastructure and business teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions.

  • Strong understanding of IT operations, software delivery lifecycles, governance frameworks, and technology strategy.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, and competing priorities across multiple initiatives.

  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a focus on delivering measurable business value through technology.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing strategic planning with operational execution.

A career that you define. Yes, we offer all the usual rewards and benefits - including medical, dental, vision, a wide variety of wellbeing offers, competitive salary, unlimited PTO, 401k with company match, paid volunteer days and more.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with the wider NBA platform stack, including React/TypeScript, Java services, and Decision Intelligence systems.
  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling, auditability, and compliance requirements.

raw.title: Lead Software Engineer - NBA

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Job Title

Deposit Growth Consultant

Overview

As a key member of the Deposit Growth Consulting team within Advisory Services, you will help financial institutions improve deposit acquisition, retention, relationship depth, product profitability, and overall financial performance. You will combine industry expertise, data analysis, and strategic consulting skills to identify opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and guide clients through initiatives that drive measurable business results.

This role is ideal for an experienced banking professional who can independently analyze complex data, lead client engagements, communicate with executive leadership, and translate insights into practical strategies that help financial institutions achieve their growth objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Consulting

· Lead deposit growth consulting engagements from discovery through final delivery, managing timelines, data requests, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.

· Facilitate workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions with executive, product, operations, retail, business, and commercial banking leaders.

· Assess deposit portfolios, product structures, pricing strategies, customer behavior, competitive positioning, and market opportunities.

· Evaluate consumer, business, and commercial deposit offerings to identify opportunities for growth, simplification, profitability improvement, and stronger customer engagement.

· Present findings and recommendations to client leadership and facilitate decision-making discussions.
