About Excel™

Ranked 6X by Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in America, and certified by Great Places to Work, Excel™ specializes in digital advertising and performance marketing, playing a pivotal role in connecting consumers with insurance brands, at scale. We partner with large strategic brands such as insurance carriers, brokers, and agencies, supplying them with high quality prospects looking for their services. This involves owning and operating top-rated insurance websites that we promote via paid search marketing driving the highest-intent consumers looking to acquire an insurance plan to meet their needs.

  • Our Vision: Acquiring great customers should be simple.
  • Our Mission: Helping insurance brands acquire the right customers at scale.
  • Our Values: E - Embrace Simplicity, X - XL Impact, C - Customer Centric, E - Extreme Ownership, L - Laser Focused.

Our team

At Excel™ we believe remote working is an important way to enable people to achieve their best work while maximizing time efficiency and personal freedom. Our culture is based on team-based performance that is highly aligned but loosely coupled, extreme ownership, growth mindset, curiosity, personal accountability, and we flourish because of the creativity and input from our team members. As an agile and innovative company, we are always looking for our next high performer to help transform the future!

Excel Impact is looking for a Data & AI Analyst to join our team and help transform data into actionable insights, scalable reporting solutions, and practical AI-powered applications. This role combines data analysis, business intelligence, AI-assisted development, automation, and emerging technologies to solve real-world business problems and drive measurable impact.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, curious, and business-oriented, with strong expertise in SQL, BigQuery, and Tableau, complemented by experience with Python and AI development tools. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex or ambiguous questions into practical data, reporting, and technology solutions.

About the role

As a Data & AI Analyst,, you will play a critical role in analyzing data, developing reporting and analytics solutions, and providing actionable insights that drive strategic business decisions. You will work with a variety of data sources and technologies, including BigQuery, SQL, Tableau, Google Sheets, APIs, and Python, while leveraging AI tools to enhance analysis, automate workflows, and improve how teams access and use data.

Beyond traditional data analysis, this role will help expand the organization’s use of AI and agentic workflows. You will have opportunities to leverage tools such as Claude Code, Google AI Studio, and other emerging AI technologies to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive processes, develop intelligent workflows, and create innovative ways for teams to access, interpret, and act on data.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical, technical, and business skills with a natural curiosity about how technology can solve real-world problems. You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous business question and turning it into a structured analysis, actionable recommendation, reporting solution, or automated workflow. You should also be excited to continuously explore new technologies and identify practical ways to improve how we work.

Most importantly, this role requires the ability to connect the full journey from business problem → data → analysis → solution → measurable business impact, using data and AI not simply as tools, but as drivers of better decisions, greater efficiency, and business performance.

Key responsibilities

  • Data Analysis & Business Intelligence: Analyze and transform data using SQL, BigQuery, and Tableau to answer business questions, identify trends, develop insights, and support decision-making. Build and maintain dashboards, reporting tools, KPIs, and analytical solutions while applying strong data visualization, data quality, and storytelling practices.
  • AI, Automation & Reporting Innovation: Leverage AI-assisted development and vibe coding tools such as Claude Code and Google AI Studio to accelerate analysis, reporting, development, and automation. Enhance dashboards, reporting workflows, and analytical tools through AI automation to create efficient and scalable solutions.
  • Business Partnership & Innovation: Translate business questions into data, analytics, reporting, automation, and AI solutions and communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Identify opportunities to improve revenue, business efficiency, quality, and decision-making, while continuously exploring emerging technologies and their practical business applications.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of hands-on SQL experience in data analysis and/or business intelligence.
  • Strong experience with Tableau and BigQuery.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Experience with Vibe Coding, Claude Code, Google AI Studio, or similar AI development tools to accelerate analysis, development, research, and automation.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into practical analytical and technical solutions.
  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills.
  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of Tableau experience.
  • Experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, MCP, LLM APIs, or AI-powered automation.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery or GCP APIs.
  • Experience developing semantic layers, analytical data models, metrics frameworks, or governed datasets.
  • Anthropic Claude Certified Developer — Foundations (CCDV-F) or equivalent hands-on AI development experience.
  • Strong interest in AI-assisted development, vibe coding, and emerging agentic technologies.

Reporting relationships

  • Reports to: DIrector of Data
  • Direct reports: None

Compensation mix

  • Fixed base salary
  • Variable performance bonus
  • Transactional Bonus
  • $1,000 Learning Allowance/year
  • Separate budget for conferences/events
  • Company-sponsored benefits

Benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Short term disability insurance
  • Long term disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible schedule
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave

Some benefits may vary depending on applicability/availability.

Perks

  • Holidays, vacation, and personal paid time-off
  • Work-life flexible while committed to growth
  • The entire company is remote/work from home
  • Company provided computer hardware/software
  • Unlimited growth and development opportunities

Next steps

If you are interested in this opportunity, want to grow with a company that is invested in you and the future, apply now to be considered for this position! It is highly recommended you read our culture memo at before applying to ensure you could be a good cultural fit.

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, results-driven, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a high-performing team. raw.description:
TaxTalente ist eine junge Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende und Unternehmen in der Steuerberatung. Unser Anspruch ist es, Bewerbern in der Steuerberatung das Leben zu vereinfachen und ihnen zu ihrem Traumjob zu verhelfen. Auf Basis deiner Wünsche können wir dir deinen passenden Job, aus der Vielzahl von Top-Kanzleien in unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk vorschlagen und dir vollumfänglich mit unserer Expertise beratend zur Seite stehen.

Derzeit suchen wir nach einer Steuerfachkraft (Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Weingarten. Falls du woanders wohnst, ist dies kein Problem, da 100% Homeoffice ebenfalls möglich ist.

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Dein Aufgabenbereich kannst du dir auf Basis deiner persönlichen Präferenzen selbst aussuchen.

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern
  • Unterstützung bei Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die deinen Interessen entsprechen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich

Interested? Click here to apply now!

 

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we are advancing the future of Artificial Intelligence by helping AI systems understand, process, and generate human speech with greater accuracy and naturalness.

As an AI Speech & Audio Specialist in our AI Community, you will contribute to the development and improvement of next-generation speech AI technologies, including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Voice AI, and audio machine learning systems.

We rely on our global community of specialists to evaluate, create, refine, and improve high-quality speech and audio datasets. Your expertise in audio production, speech analysis, linguistics, or voice technology will help ensure AI models deliver natural, accurate, culturally relevant, and human-like voice experiences.

At TELUS Digital, you will play a key role in shaping how AI listens, understands, and communicates with people around the world.

 

Key Responsibilities:

·         Evaluate AI-generated speech (TTS) for naturalness, pronunciation accuracy, rhythm, tone, emotion, and overall voice quality.

·         Review and improve speech recognition outputs (ASR) by identifying transcription errors, pronunciation issues, accents, and linguistic nuances.

·         Perform professional audio editing tasks including segmentation, trimming, noise reduction, silence adjustment, and quality enhancement.

·         Analyze audio recordings using waveform and spectrogram-based tools to identify quality issues.

·         Support the creation and validation of high-quality speech datasets used for AI model training and evaluation.

·         Review voice recordings for clarity, consistency, articulation, and technical quality.

·         Perform audio quality checks including loudness levels, background noise detection, clipping, distortion, and export specifications.

·         Support voice AI projects including TTS, ASR, voice generation, voice similarity, voice mimicry, and conversational AI evaluation.

·         Apply expertise in phonetics, linguistics, audio engineering, or speech technology to improve AI-generated voice experiences.

Mandatory Qualifications:

Minimum of one of the following:

·         Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in:

·         Audio Engineering

·         Sound Engineering

·         Music Technology

·         Linguistics

·         Phonetics

·         Speech-Language Pathology

·         Computational Linguistics

·         Computer Science (Speech/AI focus)

·         Related audio or speech fields

 

OR

Professional experience in:

 

·         Audio production

·         Sound design

·         Dialogue editing

·         Voice recording

·         Podcast/audio post-production

·         Speech data creation

·         AI speech projects

·         Technical Experience:

·         Experience with at least one professional audio tool:

·         Adobe Audition

·         iZotope RX

·         Pro Tools

·         Reaper

·         Audacity

·         Logic Pro

·         Cubase

·         Other Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs)

 

Knowledge of:

·         Audio editing and restoration

·         Speech segmentation

·         Spectrogram analysis
